label: Oxygen
description: Oxygen mole fraction of the oxidizer. For most tests this is the ambient atmosphere in the chamber; for inverse flames it is the oxidizer stream fed through the burner (see o2_basis).

label: Oxygen refers to
description: "ambient" when oxygen describes the atmosphere surrounding the fuel; "oxidizer stream" when oxygen is injected into a fuel atmosphere (inverse flames).

label: Pressure
description: Total pressure of the test atmosphere.

label: Nitrogen
description: Nitrogen mole fraction of the ambient atmosphere.

label: Carbon dioxide
description: Carbon dioxide mole fraction of the ambient atmosphere (a suppressant in FLEX).

label: Helium
description: Helium mole fraction of the ambient atmosphere.

label: Diluent
description: Inert gas or gases making up the balance of the atmosphere.

label: Flow speed
description: Speed of the forced gas flow past the fuel.

label: Flow direction
description: Direction of the forced flow relative to flame spread: concurrent or opposed.

label: Ambient temperature
description: Initial temperature of the test atmosphere.

label: Flame type
description: normal (fuel flows into oxidizer) or inverse (oxidizer flows into fuel).

label: Electric-field polarity
description: Polarity of the high-voltage mesh electrode relative to the burner.

label: Test date
description: Date of the test or session (ISO format).

label: Investigator
description: Principal investigator whose test matrix the run belongs to.

label: Description
description: Free-text description from the PSI table.

label: Notes
description: Operator comments from the PSI table.

label: Fuel or material
description: Fuel species or solid material

label: Fuel phase
description: gas, liquid or solid.

label: Fuel fraction
description: Mole (volume) fraction of fuel in the fuel stream; the rest is inert diluent.

label: Fuel diluent
description: Inert gas mixed into the fuel stream.

label: Fuel flow rate
description: Mass flow rate of fuel.

label: Oxidizer flow rate
description: Mass flow rate of oxygen through the burner (inverse flames).

label: Geometry
description: Shape of the fuel sample or burner.

label: Characteristic size
description: Droplet, burner, nozzle, rod or sphere diameter.

label: Sample thickness
description: Thickness of a solid sample.

label: Sample length
description: Length of a solid sample.

label: Sample width
description: Width of a solid sample.

label: Oxygen at end of test
description: Oxygen mole fraction measured after the test.

label: Carbon dioxide at end of test
description: Carbon dioxide mole fraction measured after the test.

label: Carbon monoxide at end of test
description: Carbon monoxide concentration measured after the test.

label: Adiabatic flame temperature
description: Calculated adiabatic flame temperature for the test's reactants.

label: Stoichiometric mixture fraction
description: Zst - where the flame sits between the fuel and oxidizer sides.

label: Peak burner temperature
description: Highest burner surface temperature reached.

label: Heater resistance ratio
description: Rt/R0, the heater wire's resistance relative to room temperature - a proxy for sample heating temperature in the smoke experiments.

label: Heating time
description: How long the sample was heated to generate smoke.

label: Smoke aging time
description: Time the smoke was held before measurement.

label: Mass loss rate
description: Rate at which the heated sample lost mass.

label: Igniter power
description: Electrical power applied to the igniter.

label: Ignition time
description: How long the igniter was powered.

label: Ignited
description: Whether a hot flame was established.

label: Flames ignited
description: Number of flames ignited in a test session (session-level tables).

label: Burn time
description: Duration of burning.

label: How the test ended
description: Self-extinguished, flow terminated, extinction, disruption or burned to completion.

label: Burning-rate constant
description: Droplet burning-rate constant. The PSI column header reads "Burning rate; mm"; droplet burning-rate constants are conventionally reported in mm²/s and the values are in that range.

label: Extinction diameter
description: Droplet diameter at which the visible flame went out.

label: Flame spread rate
description: Speed at which the flame moved along a solid sample in microgravity.

label: Burn length
description: Length of a solid sample consumed in microgravity.

label: Flame spread rate at 1 g
description: Spread rate of the same material in the normal-gravity comparison test.

label: Burn length at 1 g
description: Burn length of the same material in the normal-gravity comparison test.

label: Cool flame observed
description: Whether a low-temperature "cool" flame was observed.

label: Flame colour
description: Visible colour of the flame as logged by the science team.
